text:
**Legal compliance cannot be determined from this evidence alone.** The JRC dataset shows no forest on the property in 2020. The analysis did not count any post-baseline loss events: it detected 0.4 hectares of loss in 2021, but the patches were below its 0.5-hectare event threshold.

The data also show tree-cover loss before the 2020 baseline, including 67.7 hectares in 2020. Whether any clearing was lawful depends on applicable laws, permits and the nature of the vegetation. The MGAP 2021 source was unavailable, so relevant official records and permits should be checked.
